_meta.quat_order: wxyz (source columns quat.w,x,y,z; wxyz gives head-frame within-record std 3.91 cm vs 7.98 cm for xyzw)
_meta.keypoints: 21 per hand, MediaPipe topology: 0 wrist, thumb 1-4, index 5-8, middle 9-12, ring 13-16, pinky 17-20
_meta.head_frame: p_h = R(q)^T (p_w - H); R maps head->world

candidates._note: rigidity_cm: mean within-record std of the point in the palm frame (lower = the point is rigidly attached to the hand); jitter_ratio: median 2nd-difference / median 1st-difference (lower = less noise); finger_pose_sensitivity_cm: within-record std of the distance to the palm centre (higher = the point moves when fingers flex); pinch_dist_cm: median distance to the thumb-tip/index-tip midpoint (grasp point); centroid_dist_cm: median distance to the centroid of all 21 keypoints; cross_dataset_spread_m: max-min of the dataset mean distance to head.

stages.note: frames inside a record are autocorrelated, so the chi-square p-value is anti-conservative; Cramer's V and the KL table are the effect-size read-out.

agreement_with_reference.note: agreement = share of frames inside a reference segment whose rule-derived stage equals the class implied by the segment text, taking the better hand. segment_coverage_any_hit = share of reference segments in which the predicted class appears at least once. This is agreement with a reference annotation, not accuracy: the reference is neither error-free nor independent physical ground truth, and reach/transport have no reference labels.

baselines.note: target = palm-centre position at t+1 expressed in the head frame at t; features = [1, pos_t, vel_t, aperture_t]; ridge alpha=1e-3; errors are Euclidean, metres, on test environments only.
